name: streak-calendar
title: Streak Calendar
description: A streak tracker drawn three ways: a 365-day contribution heatmap, a month grid and a current-week row. Active days fill in, used freezes turn blue, today is ringed and future days dim.
use: A habit or learning app needs a whole year of daily activity at a glance, with a close-up month and week.
avoid: It only draws the periods you pass: it calculates no streak, has no month navigation and no data fetching.
a11y: Cells expose full date labels and grid roles, but nothing explains that the blue squares are freezes. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three bordered dark cards. A wide year heatmap of tiny rounded squares runs in week columns, below it a seven-column month grid with weekday letters, and beside that a row of seven circles captioned with weekday names. Filled days are pale, freeze days bright blue.
behaves: Each view paints the streak periods it is given: active days fill, freeze days tint blue, today gets a ring and future days fade out. Hovering a year cell opens a date tooltip, and every day is a button that can report a click and takes a focus ring.
customise: Streak periods arrive as an array of date ranges; view, month, reference date, start of week, freeze visibility and a day-click handler are props. Cell sizing stays in the source.
weight: light: About 365 small cells plus a tooltip each; nothing animates after the first render.
